title: Spicy Egyptian Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy kebab recipe inspired by Egyptian cuisine. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Thread chicken, onions, and Serrano peppers onto skewers.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, grill or toast Egyptian flatbread for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy.
Assemble kebabs by placing a few slices of ham on each flatbread, followed by a kebab.
Optional: Serve with a side of tzatziki sauce or a simple green salad.
